newsitem.title: USA: Raymond James' Sayler elected to PSA board.
newsitem.headline: Raymond James' Sayler elected to PSA board.

text.p: Van Sayler, manager of Raymond James & Associates Inc's fixed-income department in St. Petersburg, Fla., was elected to Public Securities Association's Board of Directors.
Sayler began his term on the bond market trade group's board on Sept 20, filling the unexpired term of a member who resigned. He will be eligible for a full three-year term beginning Jan 1, 1997.
Currently vice chairman of PSA's regional advisory committee, Sayler chairs the association's technology clearinghouse subcommittee.
He graduated from Vanderbilt University and received his MBA from University of South Florida.
